endorsements.label: Meet the VCs
endorsements.description: Venture capital investments have reached the highest level since the dot-com days. Almost seven billion dollars was invested last quarter alone. While clean-tech deals hit a new low, security deals increased the most. Security is the new black. How should we spend the next billion? Meet the VCs and strategize on the future!
